name: ECK Site Settings per Domain
description: Integrates the ECK Site Settings and Domain modules by allowing setting data to be different per domain.
project_description: Submodule of ECK Site Settings. Integrates ECK Site Settings with the Domain module so that a settings bundle can hold different field values per domain. Enable it per bundle by ticking 'Allow different settings per domain' on the ECK bundle form; the submodule then installs a required 'field_domain_access' entity-reference field on that bundle and scopes settings loads to the active domain via the eck_site_settings context/values alter hooks.
